name: rename-redo-autoclaim
what: rt-converge's 6006 class (an accepted limit, as 127; phase 6 ends it): James renames Drums to T1, undoes it, and redoes it in the same moment Cee turns Drums' fader, which auto-claims Drums for Cee under its old name; the two cross (James and Cee can't reach each other from 58 to 64 s). If Cee's computer answers the rename (sync.set_back), the Redo is lost. Both must stand on all three: T1, at Cee's 0.5. Passes at bf500ba (sync.receive's soft_ok: a change that merges with the auto-claimer's own lands at once, so the fader and the rename merge by setting); the 6006 seed's own sequence no longer fails there either. Kept as the guard for that path through phase 6.

edits.lua: local c = sync.my_claims(cfg, SONG, ROOM); if c then c.tracks = {}; sync.set_claims(cfg, SONG, ROOM, c) end

checks.what: James's Redo and Cee's fader both stand: T1 at 0.5
checks.lua: local t = track('T1'); assert(t and not track('Drums'), 'the track is ' .. tostring((F.tracks[1] or {}).name)); assert(math.abs(reaper.GetMediaTrackInfo_Value(t, 'D_VOL') - 0.5) < 1e-9, 'T1 volume ' .. reaper.GetMediaTrackInfo_Value(t, 'D_VOL'))
